in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: Lewis; sex and weight not stated
in_vivo_species.quote: Lewis rats received a single subcutaneous injection in the scruff of the neck

in_vitro_detail: Kv1.3 blockade by electrophysiology and TEM cell proliferation inhibition.

agents.name: PEG-HsTX1[R14A]
agents.sequence_source: Not printed in the body; PEPlife2's string is the HsTX1[R14A] scorpion-toxin peptide. The PEG moiety is not encoded.
agents.dose_route_quote: Lewis rats received a single subcutaneous injection in the scruff of the neck (500 μL/rat) of vehicle alone ... or of 1 mg/kg PEG-HsTX1[R14A].
agents.half_life_matrix: rat serum - PEG detected, not the peptide

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: PEG-HsTX1[R14A] was detectable in serum 2 h after injection and peaked at 24 h after injection with 13.8 ± 2.5 μg/mL
concentration_time_figure.note: Serum sampled to 672 h (28 days); half-life from a single exponential decay fit.

bioanalytical_method: Anti-PEG ELISA (PEGylated protein ELISA kit, Enzo Life Sciences); single exponential decay fit
bioanalytical_quote: The amount of circulating PEG-HsTX1[R14A] was quantified using a PEGylated protein ELISA kit according to the manufacturer's protocol (Enzo Life Sciences)
notes: The single PEPlife2 value of 37.3 h is verified against the Results text. TWO CAVEATS. (1) THE ASSAY DETECTS PEG, NOT THE PEPTIDE - quantitation is by an anti-PEG antibody ELISA, so the decay measured is that of the PEG moiety and would not distinguish intact conjugate from PEG still carrying a degraded or cleaved peptide. PEPlife2 records the assay as 'Anti-PEG ELISA', which preserves this, but the half-life is filed against the peptide sequence. (2) tmax is 24 h against a 37.3 h half-life, so this subcutaneous profile is substantially absorption-limited and the terminal value is not a pure clearance half-life. The PEG that causes the effect is not in the stored sequence; the body notes comparable unPEGylated peptide Kv1.3 blockers have rat half-lives 'of less than one hour', so essentially the entire 37-fold extension is attributable to the unencoded moiety. No group size or dispersion on the half-life is given.
